overrides_applied.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 (filed 2026-05-27, accession 0001193125-26-241850), Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows (p. F-6): the operating-activities reconciliation for FY2026, FY2025 and FY2024 is enumerated in full (depreciation $1,183,133k / $971,933k / $817,889k, premium amortization, debt-issuance amortization, interest credited to policyholders, disposal gains/losses, deferred taxes and working-capital changes) with no share-based or stock-based compensation line anywhere in it, and the listed items reconcile exactly to the reported operating cash flow ($1,794,584k / $1,454,429k / $1,452,756k) with no SBC addback. The terms 'share-based' and 'stock-based' appear nowhere in the filing, EDGAR companyfacts carries no ShareBasedCompensation or AllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpense fact for CIK 4457 in any year, and weighted average shares were flat at 196,077,880 combined throughout FY2024-FY2026.
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:sbc — SBC missing for FY2024, FY2025, FY2026 under every engine tag because the filer recognizes no equity-settled share-based compensation in those years: there is no SBC expense inside or outside operating cash flow to subtract, so the filing-proven value is $0. The ESOP holds already-outstanding shares (686,697 voting shares per the 10-K) and the 2016 shelf stock option plan produced no expense, issuance or share-count change in the period.

overrides_applied.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 (filed 2026-05-27, accession 0001193125-26-241850), Note 4 Earnings Per Share (pp. F-17/F-18) and the Consolidated Statements of Operations: weighted average shares outstanding are stated on a 'Basic and diluted' basis for both classes — Voting Common Stock 19,607,788 plus Series N Non-Voting Common Stock 176,470,092 equals a total of 196,077,880 — with the identical total for FY2026, FY2025 and FY2024; EPS is computed under the two-class method with basic and diluted the same.
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:shares — DILUTED shares missing for FY2024, FY2025, FY2026 in companyfacts because the filer tags only WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesOutstandingBasic (at the combined 196,077,880); its own EPS note states that this combined count IS the basic and diluted denominator for both share classes, so the filing-sourced diluted count is 196,077,880. The override changes no per-share figure (the engine already used this count as the fallback); it certifies it as the diluted count the filing itself reports.

NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2024, 2025, 2026 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
